why: The statement asks for the maximiser of φ on K_n for every n, so each dimension-restricted or class-restricted result is a case, never whole; no source covers n = 6 to 15. Pang (n ≥ 17) and Kafidov (n = 16) are serious unrefereed preprints with no identified error, so credible and unreviewed; Kafidov's own disclosure says GPT-5.6 Sol produced the strategy and the central lemma, which is generated. Li–Xiong–Yang's exact rational SOS certificate is an explicit object verifiable by exact arithmetic, so checkable; the undefined v1 'agent-guided' wording names no system, so ai_role none. The n = 5 repository is also an explicit certificate, but its validity depends on an encoding nobody has checked and its own maintainer disclaims it, so I left it unreviewed and doubtful rather than checkable. The certificates are proof objects, not objects the statement asks for, so object_role is null. Hwang–Sohn–Kim settles nothing (none); the monotonicity paper asks a changed question (variant); Lavi is a different conjecture (variant). The undated Hwang PSD event is placed before the snapshot because its sources are 1986/1987 citations.
doubts: The Li–Xiong–Yang v1 'agent-guided' language may conceal AI involvement; with no system named, it is scored none. Checkable for Li et al. assumes the certificate encodes the stated quartic correctly; the record did not run it. Divya–Somasundaram's refereed n = 4 scope is unconfirmed.
